## 5. Guidance Relevant to User’s Question – Functions Using LWLock

Identify functions relying heavily upon Lightweight Locks (`LWLock`) necessitating careful synchronisation measures given widespread adoption throughout internal subsystems:

```sql
SELECT r.pid,
       r.usename AS username,
       r.query_start,
       l.mode,
       l.locktype,
       relname
FROM pg_stat_activity r
JOIN pg_locks l ON r.pid = l.pid
LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON l.relation = c.oid;
```

Where applicable substitute `pg_locks.lwlock` column values regarding explicit references made exclusively to light-weight locks.
